answer: We model Sybil resistance via a security terrace of staking collateral, where each identity incurs a dynamic opportunity-cost bond B verified by a zero-knowledge delay quill. Under a subgame-perfect slashing matrix, any coordinate deviation triggers a malicious-signature ripple of cascading penalties P > B. For an adversary deploying k identities, the expected utility U(k) = k(V - B) - P is strictly negative for all k > 1, establishing decentralized honest validation as the unique, strict Nash equilibrium.
